name: Curtains the Clown
detailed_description:
Note about the demo:

Gamepads can be used for game play, however they are not currently enabled for navigating the main menu and pause menu. Selections must be made using the mouse. This will be corrected soon.

About

Solo project and first game ever by GrimClownJay, Curtains the Clown is a short side-scrolling adventure with multiple possible outcomes. Use simple platforming mechanics like wall jumps and double jumping to guide Curtains through a treacherous 2D world in search of a way to continue (or end) his journey. Hidden away in seemingly unreachable places are 6 items that hold the keys to various exits. Find and bring an item to its corresponding NPC/world object to discover what fate will become of our clown friend.

The Plot

Curtains is an alien life form who inexplicably resembles a rather scary looking clown. For this reason, he was exiled from his home planet and forced to find somewhere else to make his own. While passing through a distant galaxy, he made an emergency landing when his ship's fuel cells ran dry. Now stranded in a far away world, Curtains must find fuel for his ship and return to space, but perhaps there is another way to continue his journey... or meet his end before it even begins?

Features

  • Wall jump, double jump, bunny hop and "boost" to navigate the perilous platforming sequences

  • Featuring original assets and characters created and animated by GrimClownJay

  • Seamless hand-made world to explore with no loading

  • 2 modes of play - "Casual" for a more forgiving experience. "Grim" for the developer intended challenging experience (tested and proven difficult.)

  • 6 possible endings

  • Original soundtrack composed by GrimClownJay and markyard44

  • Drawn in the style of MSPaint

    Developer's note

    For the last 30+ years, It has been my dream to make and release my own game. On September 16 2023, I began a learn-as-I-go process for making a 2D game in Unreal Engine 5 using the Curtains character. Curtains the Clown is the result of finally living my dream despite my complete lack of game development knowledge and or skills. It is my hope that it inspires others to start their own journey and make their own games as well. If a clown like me can do it without any previous experience (or AI,) you can do it too!



    After release, I will still be paying close attention to CTC by finding ways to get it as optimized as possible while paying attention to player feedback. I hope you have fun with my little game!

short_description: Meet Curtains. An exiled alien clown in search of a home. While passing through a distant galaxy, he was forced to land when his ship's fuel cells ran dry. Now stranded in a far away world, Curtains must find fuel for his ship and return to space... or perhaps another way to continue his journey?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10?
  • Processor: i5-8250U 1.6GHz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or equivalent 128MB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 715 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: These requirements are based off of the oldest/weakest hardware I was able to test on. Feel free to try the demo if you feel you have weaker hardware. Disk space required is for the demo only and is subject to change.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10!
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core 3.60Ghz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 715 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: These are the specifications for the PC that I used to build the game and are not required to run the demo.
